forecast.today: A wet start with widespread rain, drizzle and some mist. The rain will be very heavy and persistent at times with the chance of localised flooding. Drier conditions will develop through the morning and afternoon with some sunny spells following too. Highest temperatures of 15 to 19 degrees, with light to moderate north to northwest winds backing westerly.
forecast.tonight: Starting off with a mix of cloud and clear spells and just a few showers. However, as the night progresses scattered showers or more persistent spells of rain will develop and some of these will be very heavy. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 15 degrees, with mostly light southerly winds, freshening in the southwest towards morning.
forecast.tomorrow: Widespread showers or more persistent spells of rain. These will be very heavy at times with thunderstorms and localised flooding possible. Some sunny spells will develop through the day. Highest temperatures of 16 to 19 degrees, with light to moderate, fresh at times, variable winds.
